items.t: Windshield pillar trim can come loose in a crash
items.job: Inspect and replace A-pillar trim clips
items.note: Free under recall 70D4. Check the VIN first.

items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: Engine damage after a chain jump costs far more than this preventive job.
Dealers start with a measured oil consumption test before approving this repair.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leak coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing assembly

items.t: Sunroof drains leak and can corrode an airbag inflator
items.job: Inspect and coat or replace curtain airbag inflator; clear drains
items.note: Free under recall 17V-001. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front sunroof glass can crack in extreme cold
items.note: Free under recall 60B2. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electric coolant pump can overheat and catch fire
items.note: Free under recall 18V-229. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump flange can crack and leak
items.job: Replace fuel pump flange or apply protective film
items.note: Free under recall 16V-660 (Audi code 20Z8). Check the VIN first.

items.t: Auxiliary heater connector can corrode and melt
items.job: Replace auxiliary heater and update software
items.note: Free under recall 80C5 / 80C6. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Seat-mounted side airbag inflator can rupture
items.note: Free under recall 69M1. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Vehicle can roll away in Park
items.note: Free under recall 37K6. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Airbags and seat belt tensioners may not fire
items.job: Replace affected airbags and seat belt pretensioners
items.note: Free under an Audi safety recall on early-build 2018 Q5. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Valve cover bolts may be loose and leak oil
items.job: Inspect and retighten or replace cylinder head cover screws
items.note: Free under recall 25V-294. Check the VIN first.
